**Is your feature request related to a problem?**
A clear and concise description of what the problem is. Example: I can't do X because…

**Describe the solution you'd like**
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

**Describe alternatives you've considered**
Any alternative solutions or workarounds you've considered.

**Which module would this affect?**
- [ ] Core (`/lumi`, `/module`, permissions)
- [ ] Moderation (`/ban`, `/kick`, `/warn`, etc.)
- [ ] Auto-Filter
- [ ] Utility (`/serverinfo`, `/whois`, `/afk`, etc.)
- [ ] AFK
- [ ] Logging
- [ ] Dashboard
- [ ] New module
- [ ] Infrastructure / Deployment

**Additional context**
Add screenshots, mockups, or other context here.
